constraints: This policy consumes only compact scorer-entry candidates with positive reads.
Raw reads, RPM, and ranks remain attached to individual seq_id tests and are never summed across tests.
DNA/RNA concordance and multiple tests from one specimen form one technical reproducibility axis, not independent clinical confirmations.

Route A is reserved for same-molecule technical repetition and requires exact-species mapping, lower-respiratory context, at least two accepted branches, rank 1 and RPM >= 10 in every branch, no DNA/RNA cross-molecule support, and excludes an explicit same-library rerun.
Route A can create High review only and never Picked.
Candidate forwarding is separated from the final Picked decision.
Phenotype evidence is not used by this analytical scorer.
No patient is forced to have a Picked candidate.
The policy is answer blind; benchmark answers are used only by a separate evaluator.
